name: braintrust
summary: I successfully fetched the Braintrust evaluation quickstart docs and installed the required Python SDKs (`braintrust-0.40.0`, `autoevals-0.3.0`, `openai-1.72.0`) via pip. I then wrote the `movie_matcher.py` eval script following the quickstart's Python example, adapting it to use the Braintrust Gateway with only the provided `BRAINTRUST_API_KEY`. However, the eval could not execute because all outbound HTTPS connections from the sandbox are blocked at the TLS handshake level—both `curl -v https://api.braintrust.dev` and `curl -v https://gateway.braintrust.dev` fail with `Recv failure: Connection reset by peer` during `SSL_connect`, and the Python script throws the same `ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer')`. No eval run was executed and no scores were reported due to this network restriction.
